entity.the_beyond.abyssal_nomad.descript: A mysterious neutral mob that wanders the End and remembers those who offer it Remembrances.
entity.the_beyond.enadrake.description: A friendly End mob that can be befriended with gifts and retreats into an Enadrake Hut.
entity.the_beyond.enatious_totem.descrip: A hostile living totem that rises from the ground and attacks with roots and shockwaves.
entity.the_beyond.enderglop.description: A small End creature that grows armor as it matures.
entity.the_beyond.gravistar.description: A floating star-shaped creature that pulls nearby creatures toward it.
entity.the_beyond.knockback_seed.descrip: A thrown seed that bursts and knocks nearby creatures away.
entity.the_beyond.lantern.description: A gentle floating mob that can be befriended with a Soul Torch and brushed for a gift.
entity.the_beyond.poison_seed.descriptio: A thrown seed that bounces and bursts into a cloud of poison.
entity.the_beyond.rising_block.descripti: A temporary block that rises from the ground before disappearing.
entity.the_beyond.totem_of_respite.descr: A floating totem that activates when its bearer would die and preserves their items.
entity.the_beyond.unstable_seed.descript: A volatile thrown seed that may burst or fizzle out.
effect.the_beyond.deafened.description: An effect that muffles the sounds around its victim.
effect.the_beyond.nomads_blessing.descri: An effect granted by an Abyssal Nomad that protects and strengthens its recipient.
effect.the_beyond.unstable.description: An effect that makes its bearer dangerously unpredictable.
effect.the_beyond.weightless.description: An effect that makes its bearer light enough to float.
